# Large Project Test Fixture

This fixture is designed for performance testing with 500+ components.

## Structure

Due to the large size, this fixture will be generated programmatically during testing.

## Components

- 100+ collections
- 500+ roles
- Complex dependency graphs
- Deep nesting (5+ levels)
- Used for performance benchmarking (<500ms requirement)

## Generation

Test code should generate this fixture dynamically using a script to avoid committing thousands of files to the repository.
